blocks.text: HANGS Construction Development LP. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.
Prepare the monthly statements from the adjusted trial balance of the month's close. The trial balance must balance, and every account must map to exactly one statement line in Appendix A.
Present a classified balance sheet at month-end beside the prior month-end, and an income statement for the month and the year to date. Current-year earnings are shown within partners' capital.

Compare each income statement account with the approved budget for the month and the year to date. Every variance that is more than $5,000 and more than 10% of the budgeted amount needs a written explanation from the line owner before the package is released.
Present principal due within twelve months of the balance sheet date as a current liability, from the debt schedule. The reclassification is for presentation only and is not a journal entry.
Job cost must agree with Homes Under Construction after the close entries. Every job with cost in the year must have an approved budget line; a job without one is reported to the Controller.

Compute each financial covenant from the statements, on the lender's definitions. Report the headroom of each; when headroom is less than 10% of the covenant level, warn the Controller before anything goes to the lender.
The Controller reviews the package, the open items and the covenant calculations. The package and any compliance certificate are sent only after that review, by the Controller.
